title: Uniform random unicast, src != dst, same rule at 64/256/1024

load_sweep.saturation_rule: highest offered load with zero errors on all 3 seeds, drainable after measurement, no sustained backlog growth; report delivered throughput and mean latency; do not use 2x zero-load

tmax_definition: last destination tail minus source header injection
notes: Unicast only. Traversal from routing events, not theoretical hop count.
